items.title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient-Physician Communication - the AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
items.excerpt: NEJM AI randomized trial (AI-INFOCARE) testing whether AI-generated summaries of patients' prior documents, prepared before the visit, shorten consultation time and change patient-physician communication. (Online date verified via Crossref; journal page is Cloudflare-gated, abstract not retrievable.)

history_match.title: Standardized pre-consultation by a large language model agent vs ophthalmology residents: a randomized clinical trial

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction - Development and External Validation in Prospective Cohorts
items.excerpt: NEJM AI original article: an AI-enhanced digital stethoscope model to detect left ventricular dysfunction at the point of care, developed and externally validated in prospective patient cohorts. (Online date verified via Crossref.)

items.title: AI-Assisted Molecular Review Refines SMO Inhibitor Candidacy in SHH Medulloblastoma
items.excerpt: NEJM AI case study: an AI-assisted molecular tumor review changed which patients with SHH-subtype medulloblastoma were judged candidates for SMO-inhibitor therapy. (Online date verified via Crossref.)

items.title: AI-supported first consultation preparation in oncology: a real-world clinical usability study
items.excerpt: Real-world oncology clinic study of AI-based First Consultation Preparation (AI-FCP), an LLM that turns unstructured referral documents into structured summaries before a patient's first oncology visit, measuring workflow performance and clinician usability.

items.title: Prospective deployment of multimodal AI grading for medical student OSCEs
items.excerpt: First prospective single-center deployment of an integrated multimodal AI system grading Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) for medical students, compared against human examiners to cut grading burden.

items.title: Artificial intelligence for opportunistic osteoporosis screening on chest radiographs
items.excerpt: AI-OsRM predicts osteoporosis and low bone mineral density from routine chest X-rays; trained on 46,478 paired CXR/DXA exams from 26,757 patients and tested for clinical utility in three external cohorts.

history_match.title: Radiologists, LLMs fail at spotting AI-generated chest x-rays

items.title: Public Perceptions of Timeliness for AI Use and Human Oversight
items.excerpt: Cross-sectional JAMA Network Open study of how patients across birth generations weigh faster AI answers against waiting for human review in patient-portal messaging and mental health support; published with an invited commentary on 'waiting for the human in the loop'. (Date verified via Crossref.)

items.title: Keeping artificial intelligence agents within the clinical task
items.excerpt: Lancet Digital Health comment: general-purpose AI agents (ChatGPT Work, Codex, Claude Cowork, Claude Code) can now operate files and applications on clinicians' computers; the authors argue how to keep them scoped to the clinical task.

items.title: From code to cure: Harnessing AI for antibiotic discovery and design
items.excerpt: Science Translational Medicine review of AI for designing synthesizable small-molecule and peptide antibiotics against drug-resistant infections, plus the reporting standards, translational pathways and regulatory hurdles needed to bring them to patients.

items.title: 'AI sandboxes' are all the rage. Advocates scramble to control their future
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: as states set up regulatory 'AI sandboxes' for health AI pilots, trade groups, physician organizations and patient advocates are vying to shape the rules that would govern them.

history_match.title: Lobbyists and trade groups fight to shape how states regulate medical AI

items.title: AI will force doctors to focus on clinical reasoning, experts say
items.excerpt: At an Endpoints News panel, UCI Health and other clinical leaders said tools like OpenEvidence are reshaping which skills doctors need, shifting training toward clinical reasoning over recall.

items.title: Are Med Students Cheating if They Use AI?
items.excerpt: MedPage Today examines how medical schools are drawing lines on students' use of generative AI for coursework and exam preparation, and whether it counts as cheating.

items.title: Voice AI startup careCycle rolls out free plan comparison tool for Medicare beneficiaries
items.excerpt: CareCycle, a voice AI company serving Medicare agencies, launched a free tool that helps Medicare beneficiaries compare plans; it takes no payer payments or commissions and does not sell personal data.

items.title: New CPT codes are expanding reimbursement for AI-powered CCTA tools
items.excerpt: Category I CPT codes now give AI-based coronary CT angiography plaque analysis physician RVUs; of 1,614+ FDA-cleared AI algorithms, only three have reached Category I payment status.

items.title: Researchers develop way of adapting adult radiology AI models to pediatric population
items.excerpt: Only about 17% of FDA-authorized AI devices are labeled for children; a Nature Biomedical Engineering paper describes a method to adapt adult radiology AI models to pediatric patients despite scarce, siloed pediatric imaging data.

items.title: AI leads to lower turnaround times for high-volume imaging
items.excerpt: JACR study: multi-vendor radiology AI at scale cut report turnaround times by up to 26% for trauma imaging, but data-routing latency often decided whether AI results reached radiologists in time.

history_match.title: Bradford skin cancer waiting times cut by new AI technology

items.title: HPI: Evidence contradicts broad claims about AI, radiology workforce
items.excerpt: Neiman HPI editorial in JACR rebuts claims that AI has reduced the need for radiologists: imaging demand is projected to grow 17-27% by 2055 and radiologist workload keeps rising.

items.title: PocketHealth expands agentic AI platform
items.excerpt: PocketHealth is extending its Conductor agentic AI platform into radiology protocoling, the reading room and revenue cycle, operating API-less legacy apps and payer portals under audited least-privilege accounts.

items.title: Why Agentic AI Works in Hospitals When You Strip It Down
items.excerpt: Hospitals running many simultaneous agentic-AI pilots hit 'pilot sprawl'; this piece argues narrow, stripped-down agents are what actually work in hospital operations.
